images.alt: A single 8×50mmR Lebel cartridge lying on graph paper, brass case with a pronounced double taper and a red-banded spitzer bullet
images.caption: An 8×50mmR Lebel round with a pointed (spitzer) jacketed bullet, showing the case's characteristic rimmed, sharply tapered profile — a legacy of necking down the earlier 11×59mmR Gras case.
